purpose: Merge-only Summoning additions for Havenhythe's 2026 obelisk system, the Jackalope Archaeology familiar, and the separate Desert Holy scarab prayer-support familiar.

activity_additions.name: Havenhythe empowered Summoning obelisks
base_access: Start and progress Visions of Havenhythe
Fairy ring BKS provides later Shrine access

spirit_plane_connection.gain: Gain 1% connection when infusing a pouch at an empowered obelisk.
loss: Lose 1% when infusing at a non-empowered obelisk.
Lose 1% every 20 seconds while no pouches are being infused.

spirit_communion.trigger: Offer 100 spirit shards to a visiting Spirit Wolf at the empowered obelisks.
spirit_communion.effect: Connection percentage does not decay from pouch creation for the protected infusions and pouch creation is reduced from 4 ticks to 3 ticks.

achievements.name: Dialed In
achievements.requirement: Reach 100% Spirit Plane Connection by infusing pouches at empowered obelisks.

achievements.name: Getting Familiar
achievements.requirement: Offer 100 spirit shards to the visiting Spirit Wolf.

activity_additions.league_treatment: This is a Havenhythe production advantage, not global access to Havenhythe familiars or ingredients. Keep connection state separate from Amlodd's Voice of Seren modifier.

activity_additions.name: Jackalope familiar
activity_additions.passive: Screens stored soil over time, with a 33% chance to receive materials per soil.

special_move.name: Dig for Soil
special_move.effect: Increases the chance of finding soil while excavating by 10% for 1 minute.

activity_additions.league_treatment: Havenhythe supplies the antlers. The familiar's Archaeology utility is global after the pouch is created; do not turn it into a combat familiar or unrestricted Beast of Burden.

activity_additions.name: Holy scarab familiar

special_move.name: Bone Conjure
special_move.effect: Adds a random bone to the player's inventory.

activity_additions.league_treatment: Holy scarab is a Desert/Het's Oasis familiar. Do not associate it with Havenhythe merely because both systems use Summoning obelisks.
